description: This file defines the Security interface for authorization-related methods within the org.apache.ofbiz.security package, including permission checks, role validation, and cache clearing.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Interface defining authorization and permission check methods, including role validation and cache management.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve the Delegator instance.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Deprecated method to set the Delegator instance.

methods.name: findUserLoginSecurityGroupByUserLoginId
methods.description: Deprecated method to find security groups for a user login ID.

methods.name: securityGroupPermissionExists
methods.description: Deprecated method to check existence of a security group permission.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user session or user login has a specific permission.

methods.name: hasEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for a specific entity and action.

methods.name: hasRolePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for a specific role within an application, with various overloads for session, user login, roles list, and role validation.

methods.name: clearUserData
methods.description: Clears cached data related to a user login upon logout.
